completions.notes:
Root cause of flow 05f660fe's "Usage credits required for 1M context" found and fixed. An explicit allowedTools omitting ToolSearch turns off MCP tool-schema deferral, inlining every configured schema on the post-connect turn: 511,214 cache-creation tokens for a one-line echo, which pushes sonnet-4-6 past its 200K window onto the 1M tier. Also a cost defect: ~$3.26/trivial turn on sonnet-5 since stratum 603ec78.

Fix landed in stratum f250d9e6746276cfc79ef311fe56d1f2008ea503 (origin/main): append ToolSearch once to an explicit allowedTools, never duplicate, explicit disallow still wins, preset branch untouched. 4 RED->GREEN SDK-boundary tests; 39/39 green unsandboxed across the three touched files (tests/connectors/claude.test.ts, tests/connectors/runner.test.ts, tests/mcp/agent-run.test.ts). Rebuilt dist verified to carry the fix.

Live-fire A/B against the rebuilt dist, same process/prompt, sonnet-4-6, compose's real orchestrator list: control (ToolSearch disallowed = pre-fix) 156,992 cache-creation tokens / $0.943; treatment 53,620 / $0.323. Both PROBE_OK. Harness limit stated in the evidence: a bare node process loads a smaller MCP roster than a full session, so the probe confirms the token mechanism and cost, not the 1M refusal itself.

Codex review (sol/high) REVIEW CLEAN: precedence correct for all six allow/deny combinations; ToolSearch cannot recover an explicitly denied tool so the security boundary does not widen; the one other SDK-options builder (stratum app/server/agent-server.js:153) uses the preset and needs nothing.

tests_pass attests the targeted stratum suites above, run unsandboxed. compose side is docs-only (pre-push gate skipped the suite accordingly).

Two follow-ups deliberately NOT taken, recorded in design.md as open decisions: (1) whether stratum should pass settingSources/--strict-mcp-config so a compose step does not inherit the account's whole MCP roster; (2) re-pricing dispatch-ledger rows since 603ec78.
